cases.title: Login with valid credentials allows access to registration module
cases.description: Verify that a user can log in with valid credentials and reach the beneficiary registration module.
cases.preconditions: User account exists and is active; application is reachable; user is logged out.

steps.action: Open the application login page.
steps.expected_result: Login page is displayed with username and password fields and a login/submit control.

steps.action: Enter valid username and password and submit.
steps.expected_result: User is authenticated and redirected to the main landing page/dashboard.

steps.action: Navigate to the beneficiary registration module from the dashboard/menu.
steps.expected_result: Beneficiary registration screen is displayed and ready for input.

cases.title: Successful beneficiary registration creates beneficiary record without errors
cases.description: Verify that beneficiary registration completes successfully and creates a usable beneficiary record for subsequent nurse visit workflow.
cases.preconditions: User is logged in with valid credentials and is on the beneficiary registration screen.

steps.action: Fill in all mandatory beneficiary fields with valid data.
steps.expected_result: All fields accept input; no validation errors are shown.
steps.data: name=John Doe; dob=1990-01-01; gender=Male; phone=5551234567; address=123 Main St

steps.action: Submit the beneficiary registration form.
steps.expected_result: Registration completes without errors; a confirmation/success indicator is displayed; beneficiary ID or record reference is generated and visible or retrievable.

steps.action: Open the newly created beneficiary profile/details page (if available).
steps.expected_result: Beneficiary details match the submitted data and the record is in an active/registered state.

cases.title: Complete nurse visit workflow for newly registered beneficiary shows success message
cases.description: Verify end-to-end flow: register beneficiary then complete nurse visit and receive a success message.
cases.preconditions: User is logged in; a beneficiary has been successfully registered and is available for selection; nurse module is accessible to the user.

steps.action: Navigate to the nurse module from the main menu/dashboard.
steps.expected_result: Nurse module landing page is displayed.

steps.action: Search for and select the newly registered beneficiary.
steps.expected_result: Beneficiary is found and selected; nurse visit initiation screen is displayed with beneficiary context.

steps.action: Start a new nurse visit for the selected beneficiary.
steps.expected_result: A new visit session is created; visit form/workflow steps are displayed.

steps.action: Complete required nurse visit fields/steps and submit/complete the visit.
steps.expected_result: Visit is saved and marked completed; a clear success message is displayed confirming completion.

steps.action: Verify visit appears in beneficiary visit history/list.
steps.expected_result: The completed visit is listed with correct date/time/status and is associated with the beneficiary.

cases.title: Navigation: user can move from registration confirmation to nurse module and continue workflow
cases.description: Verify navigation flow after successful registration supports proceeding to nurse visit without losing context.
cases.preconditions: User is logged in and has just successfully registered a beneficiary; registration success/confirmation view is displayed.

steps.action: From the registration success/confirmation view, use available navigation to go to nurse module (button/link/menu).
steps.expected_result: User is navigated to nurse module without errors.

steps.action: Locate the newly registered beneficiary in nurse module (via search or recent list).
steps.expected_result: Newly registered beneficiary is discoverable and selectable.

steps.action: Start and complete a nurse visit for the newly registered beneficiary.
steps.expected_result: Nurse visit completes and a success message is displayed.

cases.title: verify registered beneficiary is visible in nurse module and visit flow shows follow up, screening, chief complaint and referral fields
cases.description: verify that newly registered beneficiary is displayed in nurse module and nurse can proceed with beneficiary visit where follow up, screening, chief complaint and referral fields are available
cases.preconditions:
1\. user must be logged into hwc application with nurse role\.
2\. beneficiary must be successfully registered in the system\.
3\. application should be accessible\.
cases.postconditions:
1\. nurse should be on beneficiary visit details screen\.
2\. visit workflow should be ready for further data entry\.

steps.action:
1\. login to hwc application with nurse credentials\.
2\. navigate to nurse module\.
3\. search the newly registered beneficiary using name / mobile number / beneficiary id\.
4\. verify beneficiary appears in the list\.
5\. select the beneficiary\.
6\. click on start visit / proceed option\.
7\. navigate to beneficiary visit details screen\.
8\. observe the visit form sections\.
steps.expected_result:
1\. registered beneficiary should be visible in nurse module list\.
2\. beneficiary visit should start successfully\.
3\. follow up section should be visible\.
4\. screening section should be visible\.
5\. chief complaint field should be available and editable\.
6\. referral field should be available and selectable\.
